fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities lowered Dell Technologies (DELL) price target from $497 to $341 (30% reduction), though the stock rose 2% in pre-market trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: GF expects fiscal 2027 AI server sales of $8.5 billion contributing to annual revenue exceeding $20 billion, but projects enterprise server shipments to decline 9% each in fiscal 2027–2028 and PC shipments to decline high single digits.
fields.summary_ko.2: GF cited accelerated forward sales in 2026 leading to a sharp drop in general enterprise server demand in H2 2027 and loss of SpaceX VR200 orders to Hon Hai as key weaknesses.
